narrative.weekly_mirror: After six hours shaping clay for the Becker piece, with no audience and no need to manage anyone else, you came away feeling better than you had in weeks. You wrote, "Today was just doing the thing itself."
narrative.tension_explanation: The studio gave you room to enjoy the work as making, while the Kunstverein evening showed how much recognition and standing also matter to you. The relationship between those two parts of your life remains open: one brings freedom from performance, and the other offers a kind of satisfaction you have worked hard to earn.
narrative.reflective_question: When you think back to that day with the clay, what part of being unobserved mattered most to you?

grounded_quotes: Today was just doing the thing itself.

Keep the language easy to say aloud.
